questions.question: Examples
questions.subprompt: Turning verbs into nouns can make writing sound more formal and academic. · Discourse markers like 'however' and 'furthermore' help structure an argument.

questions.question: The committee decided to delay the vote. The ___ was unexpected.
questions.explanation: Decision is the noun form of decide.

questions.question: The findings ___ indicate a relationship between the variables.
questions.explanation: Appear to indicates cautious academic interpretation.

questions.question: The proposal is ambitious. ___, it is financially realistic.
